Ambala Highway Protest: Sikh Group Clashes with Police

A protest by the Sikh Sangat in Ambala on the GT Road escalated into a clash with police. The group demanded an FIR against Gursimran Singh Mand. Police used lathi-charge and tear gas to disperse the protesters, resulting in injuries to several police personnel, including a DSP whose thumb was reportedly severed. The protest lasted for seven hours.
